role: Shared plumbing for the cloud providers' streams: ProviderStream wraps a provider operation in an AsyncThrowingStream, cancels it on consumer termination and normalises thrown errors to AIProviderError (.cancelled/.network); ProviderHTTP extensions build the sorted-key streaming POST, open the connection on the shared session (logging a connect failure's URLError code) and map a non-2xx reply through the provider's failure mapping, and hold the shared bad-endpoint and incomplete-arguments errors and the usage yield; SSEEvents reads a reply's lines as server-sent events for all three streamers.
types: SSEEvent: struct (Equatable, Sendable) — one event's name and data payload
SSEEvents: struct (AsyncSequence) — server-sent events over a line sequence
SSEEvents.Iterator: struct (AsyncIteratorProtocol) — the line iterator and the current event name

units.does: Creates an AsyncThrowingStream that runs operation in a Task and cancels that Task when the stream terminates.
Awaits operation(continuation); finishes the stream normally on return or with failure(from:) of the thrown error.

branches.effect: finishes the continuation throwing the mapped error; otherwise finish().

units.does: Maps errors: CancellationError or URLError.cancelled → AIProviderError.cancelled; other URLError → .network(localizedDescription); anything else unchanged.

branches.effect: .network(description), which the chat treats as fallbackable.

units.does: Builds the streaming POST every cloud provider sends: method POST, Content-Type application/json, Accept text/event-stream, then each of the given vendor headers, and the body JSON-encoded with .sortedKeys. Throws what encoding throws.

Opens a provider's stream: connects (connect, which logs a URLError code), then checks task cancellation; a response that is HTTP with a status outside 200...299 throws failure(status, first 4 KB of the body from errorBody); otherwise returns the body's line sequence.
writes: net:the provider endpoint in the request

branches.effect: throws failure(status, body); otherwise returns bytes.lines

units.does: Sends the request on ProviderHTTP.streamSession and returns its bytes and response; a URLError is logged as a warning ('[AIStreamer] <provider> connect failed: code=<n> (<description>)') and rethrown; other errors propagate unlogged.
writes: net:the provider endpoint in the request
mem:DebugLogger buffer (warning on a connect failure)

branches.effect: logs its code and description, rethrows

units.does: Returns .invalidResponse('tool call <name> arrived with incomplete arguments'), the error a tool call whose arguments are not a whole JSON object ends the round with.
Yields one .usage event with the given input, output, cached and cache-creation counts (cache creation 0 by default) when at least one is non-zero; yields nothing for an all-zero report.
Wraps a line sequence (the URL session's lines or a test's) as a sequence of server-sent events.
Returns an Iterator over the wrapped lines with no event name yet.
units.entry: AsyncSequence conformance: called by for-try-await over SSEEvents.

units.does: Reads lines until one completes an event (event(from:)) and returns it, checking task cancellation after every line read; returns nil when the lines end. Throws what reading a line throws, or CancellationError.
units.entry: AsyncIteratorProtocol conformance: called by for-try-await over SSEEvents (Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible consumeSSE, Gemini readChunks).

branches.cond: for each line until the sequence ends
branches.effect: loop; returns nil at the end

units.does: Reads one line: a blank line clears the event name, an 'event:' line sets it to the trimmed value (both return nil); a 'data:' line with a non-empty trimmed payload returns SSEEvent(name: current name, data: payload); every other line (comments, id:, retry:) and an empty payload return nil.

branches.cond: line empty or starts with event:
branches.effect: empty clears the name, event: stores the trimmed value; returns nil

branches.cond: line does not start with data:

units.does: Returns the line after the field prefix, trimmed of spaces and tabs.
